components.name: Existing Model Inference

components.name: Existing Qlib Backtest
components.responsibility: Execute official Qlib strategies, exchange simulation, portfolio backtest, and persistence.
current_limitations: Dataset Snapshot and Unified Signal lineage are not yet first-class inputs.

components.name: Existing Risk Analysis
components.responsibility: Analyze official Qlib portfolio and trade results.
current_limitations: QuantMind 2.0 Experiment lineage is not recorded.

components.name: Feature Snapshots
components.responsibility: Produce annual Parquet matrices consumed by existing training and expose them through a read-only immutable Snapshot boundary.

No Factor Registry lineage.

current_limitations: Python-first candidate contract.
Agent selects structure and concrete parameters together.
No formal ResearchDecision or Decision Validator boundary.
Campaign and research drivers combine decision, loop-control, dispatch, and feedback roles.
JSON registry is replaceable.
Source resides under /tmp.
No target Factor Optimization or Frozen Test isolation.

components.name: Project Knowledge
components.responsibility: Provide repository context, ADRs, implementation contracts, validation, and later API/web indexes.
current_limitations: Domain, ORM, mappers, migration 0001, async PostgreSQL Repository/UoW, self-reference-free Manifest v2 producer, strict new-v2 validation, bounded committed-v2 compatibility, trusted binding, Git consistency, Indexer, and CLI exist; API and web UI do not.
QM2-P0-006 remains Git-inconsistent because of one immutable before_hash transcription error; QM2-P0-006F records separate correction evidence without changing the old Run.
No production database has been migrated and final execution-role/schema privilege policy is not frozen.
Manifest v1 cannot construct complete Domain Bundles for historical Runs; v2 resolves future evidence production only.
At B1 base 0353435, 16 of 17 historical v1 Runs pass Git evidence but 0 of 17 are indexable; QM2-P0-001F also fails result-commit consistency.
Manifest v2 validates explicit artifact location kind before constructing the unchanged Domain object.
Read-only Unit of Work optimization is deferred and Relationship admission uses a conservative whole-graph advisory lock.
Pinned SQLAlchemy 2.0.25 and asyncpg 0.29.0 runtime parity remains unverified; isolated tests used SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 and asyncpg 0.31.0.
Mapper and technical identity algorithm versions are recorded by Manifest v2 but are not business-table columns.

components.name: Research Skill
components.responsibility: Apply research method and economic reasoning to visible evidence and emit ResearchDecision proposals.
current_limitations: Architecture contract only; no Skill runtime, prompt package, permission identity, or execution integration is implemented.

components.name: Decision Validator
components.responsibility: Validate ResearchDecision schema, permission, state, budget, duplication, evidence visibility, and Frozen Test restrictions before Run creation.
current_limitations: JSON Schema and architecture contract exist; no executable validator, policy store, or permission enforcement is implemented.

components.name: Bounded Code Orchestrator
components.responsibility: Own persistent loop state, permissions, budgets, idempotency, concurrency, Run/Artifact coordination, deterministic dispatch, retries, timeouts, and recovery.
current_limitations: Target responsibilities are accepted but no QuantMind 2.0 runtime implementation exists; V7 BoundedCampaignRunner and BoundedV7SessionOrchestrator are donor evidence, not compliant implementation.

components.name: Data Foundation
components.responsibility: TongDaXin ingestion, legacy feature binding, immutable raw/data snapshots, normalization, quality, and consumer views.
current_limitations: Real TongDaXin access is unavailable because the repository and active environments lack tqcenter.tq, and canonical volume/amount unit assertions are not configured.
Calendar and point-in-time universe domains are deferred.
Existing training and Qlib consumers have not switched to Dataset Snapshot.

components.name: Factor DSL
components.responsibility: Canonical typed AST, parameter nodes, static admission, canonicalization, hashing, and bounded compilation.
current_limitations: v1 has a closed 18-node catalog and no structure evolution, Registry lifecycle, Agent loop, API, or UI.

components.name: Factor Compute
components.responsibility: Evaluate admitted DSL Factor Instances against validated Dataset Snapshots and atomically materialize immutable Parquet Factor Values.
current_limitations: Offline single-process v1 only; no distributed compute, object storage, Registry, predictive validation, API, or database index.

components.name: Factor Optimization
components.responsibility: Deterministically search declared DSL lookback-window and factor-internal-weight parameters under explicit trial and failure budgets, then order mechanically eligible validation candidates.
current_limitations: v1 is offline, serial, parameter-only deterministic enumeration; no signal threshold, random or Bayesian search, structure evolution, distributed workers, API, database index, Registry promotion, labels, IC, model, portfolio, or backtest evaluation.
Current code is verified in the QM2-P0-005 uncommitted workspace and is not contained in last_verified_commit.

components.name: Factor Validation
components.responsibility: Materialize the audited Label Contract, validate immutable Factor Values on temporal Train and Validation splits, publish immutable candidate selection, and isolate one-time Frozen Test access.
current_limitations: Offline single-process v1 on one deterministic 300-symbol universe; no regime, cost, turnover, correlation, walk-forward, API, database index, authentication service, Registry promotion or official backtest.
The original QM2-P0-006 Implementation Run remains Git-inconsistent; QM2-P0-006F corrects only the evidence record and does not promote any candidate.

components.name: Factor Registry
components.responsibility: Register immutable Factor Instance research lineage, derive governed status, publish content-addressed snapshots, and require explicit promotion decisions.
current_limitations: Offline immutable artifact v1 only; no database, API/UI, durable artifact backend, actor authorization service, automatic redundancy analysis, LightGBM/Qlib consumption, or active Factor.
The real 14-entry Snapshot has zero promotion candidates, approved Factors, or active Factors.

components.name: Agent Research Campaign
components.responsibility: Accept closed Research Goals, obtain sanitized Agent structure proposals, enforce novelty and budgets, dispatch existing DSL/Optimization, evaluate contaminated Development feedback, and append research-only Registry entries.
current_limitations: Offline single-process artifact runtime only; no API, database index, concurrency worker, model, backtest, or promotion.
The deterministic Baseline and one admitted external Codex Campaign completed; fresh formal Validation of Agent-generated factors remains separate.
All 2025 feedback is contaminated adaptive research only and requires fresh formal Validation.

components.name: Experiment Manager
components.responsibility: Bind Agent, trials, validation, model, signal, backtest, artifacts, data, code, environment, and seed lineage.
current_limitations: Not implemented.

components.responsibility: Create immutable direction-, transform-, lag-, threshold-, and universe-aware signals for Qlib.
